Your Future with ATCO Structures & Logistics

Are you an IT support professional looking to broaden your experience beyond the help desk and build your career across systems, applications and IT administration?

ATCO Structures & Logistics is a global leader in modular design, manufacturing and construction. Across Australia, we deliver workforce accommodation villages, permanent modular buildings, offices, schools, health facilities and major infrastructure projects across the mining, energy, government and commercial sectors.

Due to continued growth, we have created a new opportunity for an IT Support & Systems Administrator to join our team based in Luscombe.

This is a varied, hands-on role providing Level 1 IT support across the business while giving you the opportunity to build your experience across Microsoft 365, SharePoint, business systems, hardware, security and broader IT administration.

Why You’ll Love Working With Us

  • Newly created role with the opportunity to make it your own.

  • Grow beyond traditional help desk support into systems, applications and broader IT.

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) supporting you and your family.

  • Opportunity to participate in the ATCO Employee Share Purchase Plan.

  • Free onsite parking at our Luscombe office.

  • Join a supportive global organisation with genuine long-term career development opportunities.

What You’ll Be Doing

Reporting to the Corporate Services Manager, you’ll provide day-to-day IT and systems support across the business, including:

  • Provide friendly and responsive Level 1 IT support, troubleshooting hardware, software and user issues.

  • Set up new users, computers, mobile devices, software, system access and permissions.

  • Support Microsoft 365, Windows, SharePoint and key business systems including Oracle

  • Coordinate IT requirements for employee onboarding and offboarding and maintain IT asset and equipment records.

  • Assist with system security, backups, software licensing, telecommunications and technology lifecycle management.

  • Work with internal stakeholders and IT providers in Australia and Canada, while supporting system improvements, implementations and IT projects.

About You

We’re looking for someone with approximately 2–5 years’ experience in IT support, help desk or a similar technical support environment who is ready to broaden their skills.

You’ll ideally bring:

  • Previous Level 1 help desk, desktop support or general IT support experience.

  • Good working knowledge of Microsoft 365, Windows applications and SharePoint.

  • Confidence troubleshooting everyday hardware, software, access and user issues.

  • Strong customer service and communication skills with a friendly and approachable manner.

  • The ability to remain calm, solve problems and effectively juggle multiple requests and priorities.

  • A relevant IT qualification and exposure to Oracle, ERP systems, ServiceNow, networking, cybersecurity & cloud technologies will be highly regarded.

Ready to Join Us?

If you enjoy solving problems, helping people and are looking to broaden your experience beyond traditional IT support into systems and applications, we’d love to hear from you.

Click Apply Now and submit your resume today.

You must have the right to live and work in Australia to be considered for this opportunity.

ATCO is an Equal Opportunity Employer and encourages applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, women and people from diverse backgrounds. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone is treated with fairness, dignity and respect.

About Nexigen Digital


We are Australia’s largest privately-owned group of online service providers, which includes brands such as VentraIP, Synergy Wholesale and Intaserve.

Every day our all-Australian team delivers exceptional service and outstanding support to our 200,000+ customers who choose us for their domain names, website hosting and digital marketing.


Over the past fifteen years, we have been constant game-changers, industry innovators, award winners, and community leaders - and now is your chance to join our team.




The Position


As a Software Engineer at Nexigen Digital, you will work with a close, agile team to deliver new projects and continuous improvements to our internal and customer facing systems. We're looking for someone who is passionate, proactive, goal oriented and posses excellent problem solving skills.

We know first hand that brilliant software engineers come from a variety of backgrounds and experiences, in fact, some of our developers started out on our own customer service help desk. We pride ourselves on maintaining a team culture that provides provides opportunities through collaboration, knowledge sharing and continuous learning and development, and as such are able to provide opportunities to a range of developers with different skillsets and experience.

An average day may include any or all of the following tasks:

  • Building secure, reliable and scalable code that can be used across our platforms
  • Working with the latest PHP web technologies such as Laravel 12 and PHP 8.4
  • Maintaining and improving our core billing and CRM systems, domain registrar platforms and our new projects in the pipeline, with opportunities to work across projects and teams
  • Work with our product managers and fellow software engineers to scope, build, test and deploy new features and fixes across our projects and products
  • Solving complex integration scenarios with external providers and suppliers
  • Learning something new

The right person (is it you?)

  • Has three or more years' experience in PHP development (we'll take personal & self taught experience into consideration as well)
  • Has a strong understanding of PHP and common web application design patterns, such as MVC
  • Has experience using PHP frameworks such as Laravel, Symfony, and Phalcon
  • Knows their way around a command line and has an understanding of Linux environments
  • Has a good understanding of relational databases using MySQL/MariaDB and is familiar with designing database schemas
  • Has previously worked with external API providers and integrated them into existing projects
  • Knows their way around git and git hosting platforms such as GitHub, with a strong understanding of version control systems
  • Is able to work collaboratively within a team environment and follow established standard processes
  • Can follow and maintain PER Coding Style guidelines
  • Maintains a great attention to detail and able to throughly test their own work to ensure a high quality hand over
  • Doesn't practice "ego driven development"

Handy things to have (or are able to learn)

  • Experience with using HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, SASS/SCSS, JavaScript, jQuery, and Tailwind
  • Experience with the React.js framework
  • Have an understanding regarding implementation of good UI/UX in web development
  • Familiar with semantic versioning and changelogs
  • Knowledge of the Domain Name and Web Hosting (cPanel, WHM, Plesk, etc.) industry is valuable
  • Experience and know how to work with Perl and Python languages
  • Experience with Agile Methodology




The Benefits of Working With the Nexigen Digital Team


Aside from being awarded “Employer of Choice” in the Australian Business Awards, we are often referred to as the Google of south-east Melbourne thanks to our unique facilities and team culture, and a top-down mandate to take care of the people who take care of our customers.

Some of the office perks include:

  • A weekly selection of delicious meals prepared in our on-site kitchen for breakfast and lunch.
  • A fully-stocked snack bar featuring an assortment of chips, chocolates, nuts, protein bars and fresh fruit.
  • A drink fridge loaded with an assortment of soft drinks, juices and water.
  • A fully equipped private gym with weekly on-site personal training sessions.
  • A team wellness centre with a sound-proof gaming stadium featuring an 85” 4K TV, racing car simulator, pinball machine, arcade machine, and air hockey table.
  • An on-site salon where our resident barber and stylist provide free haircuts on a regular basis.

We actively encourage training and upskilling for personal development and will fund courses that have a beneficial impact on the business.

Please note that due to strict security requirements the successful applicant will be required to complete a National Police Check as a condition of employment.

  • Power BI and business intelligence
  • Git and version control

Your Initial Projects

  • The opportunity to work collaboratively with an experienced IT and business team.

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to take ownership of technology that has a direct impact on how the business operates.

You will have the opportunity to solve meaningful problems, improve existing systems, build new capabilities and influence the future direction of our technology environment.

At Shred-X, our values are Safe, Smart, Sustainable and Service. We believe technology should support these values by helping our people work smarter, operate more efficiently and deliver better outcomes for our customers.

If you are a senior developer who enjoys solving problems, working closely with the business and seeing your software make a real difference, we would love to hear from you.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.

Graduate or early-career developer

Gold Coast QLD

Full-time

About 2Gen

2Gen is a Gold Coast managed services provider. We look after business IT, cloud services, cyber security, networking, VoIP and automation for small and medium businesses across Southeast Queensland.

We also build software. Business applications, integrations, automation and AI systems that our clients rely on every day. We are a small team, we give honest advice, and we have gone all in on leveraging AI to build better software faster.

The role

We are looking for a developer who works with AI first. Not the occasional question to a chatbot, but AI as the environment you actually work in, and a real interest in seeing how far it can be pushed.

You will work on real customer projects alongside our senior developers and engineers, writing and shipping code that clients depend on. The work is mostly Python and Django, JavaScript and TypeScript with React and Node, API and platform integrations, and a growing amount of AI engineering: agents, local models, retrieval and automation that we design, build and run ourselves.

This role suits someone at graduate to junior level. If you are further along than that and the rest of this ad describes you, apply anyway.

The fundamentals matter here

AI is going to write a lot of the code. Your job is to know whether it is right. That means understanding how software actually works: data structures and which one to reach for, control flow, functions and state, structured and object-oriented design, relational databases and how to model data properly, HTTP and APIs, version control, testing, and enough about algorithms and complexity to spot something that will fall over at scale.

Most people who have this learned it at university, so a computer science, software engineering or IT degree with solid results is the most direct way to show us. It is not the only way. If you have worked through a proper structured course on your own - CS50, TAFE, a serious online program - and you can talk through the theory as comfortably as the code, we will take that just as seriously.

If you can generate a working app but cannot explain what the code is doing or why, this is not the role for you.

What you will do

  • Build and ship features in Python and Django, and in JavaScript or TypeScript with React and Node, on real customer projects.

  • Build integrations against APIs such as Microsoft Graph and Microsoft 365, Xero, ERP platforms and client line-of-business systems.

  • Build practical AI systems: agents, tool integrations, retrieval and vector search, prompt and context design.

  • Help develop, test and deploy local LLMs and AI-assisted workflows, both internally and for clients.

  • Use Claude, Claude Code, Codex and similar tools as your day-to-day development environment, and review what they produce properly before it ships.

  • Write tests, read other people's code, and debug down to the actual cause rather than the first plausible one.

  • Deploy and support what you build on Azure, AWS, Google Cloud and Linux, with senior support behind you.

  • Document what you build so the next person, human or agent, can pick it up.

What else we are looking for

  • At least one language you can build something real in. Python, JavaScript or TypeScript are the most useful to us.

  • Working knowledge of Git, SQL and the command line.

  • Evidence that you finish things. Home labs, side projects, published repositories, coding experiments, AI projects. Half-built ideas are fine, as long as some of them get finished.

  • Serious AI habits already, and a genuine appetite to go deeper into agents, local models, automation and tooling.

  • The judgement to know when AI output is wrong. We want someone who uses AI constantly and still understands every line that ships.

  • Australian working rights.

If you are coming from another technical industry rather than straight out of study, that is fine, provided the fundamentals above are there and you can show us where you picked them up.

Communication

You will be working closely with our senior developers and, before long, talking to clients directly. So this matters as much as the technical side.

We are looking for someone who can explain what they are building to a person who is not a developer, write things down clearly enough that the next person can pick them up, and ask for help rather than quietly burning three days on something. When we ask where something is up to, we want a straight answer. "I am halfway through and I have hit a problem" is far more use to us than an update that sounds fine and unravels a week later.

What we offer

  • Real customer work from early on, with senior developers and engineers working alongside you.

  • Mentoring from experienced technical staff with deep MSP, cloud, infrastructure, security and automation backgrounds.

  • A team where AI-first development is simply how we work, not a trial.

  • Practical AI training and proper time to work with Claude, Claude Code, Codex, local LLMs and agent tooling.

  • Exposure to Python, Django, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node, APIs, Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, networking and cyber security.

  • A clear path into senior development, cloud, automation or AI specialist work.

  • A Gold Coast team with real client relationships and broad technology exposure.

How to apply

Apply through SEEK with your CV and a short cover note, half a page or less.

Tell us who you are, where you learned your software fundamentals, why this role interests you, how you use AI in your own work now, and what you have built. Include links to anything you are proud of: a repository, a project, an agent, an app, a home lab. One thing you actually finished is worth more to us than a long list of technologies.

We should probably start by explaining what this role isn't.


It's not sitting three layers above delivery.

It's not spending six months designing the perfect product framework.

And it's definitely not being an armchair product expert.


Refactor is exclusively partnering with an established Australian digital marketplace to find a hands-on Product Lead to own the next phase of its product.


The brief was summed up brilliantly by the hiring team:

They don't need another chef designing the menu. They need someone who can actually cook.


The opportunity:


You'll become the key product person for an established B2B marketplace, owning the customer experience and working directly across Engineering, Design, Data, Sales and commercial leadership.


You'll help shape strategy.


But you'll also be expected to turn that strategy into things customers can actually use.


Think:

Discover → validate → build → launch → measure → improve.

Then go again.


What you'll be doing

  • Owning product vision and priorities

  • Identifying opportunities for customer and commercial growth
  • Running discovery and turning problems into product solutions

  • Genuine relocation support if the Gold Coast lifestyle is calling
  • Hybrid set up 2 days in office out of Brisbane or Gold Coast - 3 flexible days
  • Regular hackathons and a real learning budget, not just the promise of one


Who we're looking for:


We're deliberately not getting hung up on title.


You might currently be a:

Product Lead. Senior Product Manager. Principal Product Manager. Or even Head of Product within a smaller business.


What matters is that you're still hands-on.


You can talk strategy with an executive in the morning, work through a customer problem with Sales before lunch and jump into a delivery session with Engineering that afternoon.


Experience across marketplaces, e-commerce, SaaS, FinTech, PropTech, travel or another customer-facing digital product would be particularly interesting.


We want someone who can tell us:

“I found this problem. We tested it. We built this. We launched it. Here's what happened.”


Not just:

“My squad delivered…”


Why consider it?

It's an unusual combination.


You get the customers, data, stability and resources of an established digital business, while retaining the ownership you'd normally associate with something much smaller.


There's also a genuine opportunity to bring newer technology, AI and product thinking into a market that's ripe for innovation.


Established platform. Big backing. Genuine ownership.


And it's based on the Gold Coast.

Could be worse.
